The three calendars and entries marked appSeeded are what the app itself seeds for every test user (lib/seed-emulator-fixtures.ts: MINIMONSTER four days ago and three days on, the mini training plan three days on); the recorder does not write them, and the Ranger side anchors their dateOffset to today.
